name: Red-shouldered/Broad-winged Hawk
desc: Red-shouldered/Broad-winged Hawk (Buteo lineatus): a top predator in this web. Recorded 1,573 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The red-shouldered hawk is a medium-sized buteo. Its breeding range spans eastern North America, along the coast of California and northern to northeastern-central Mexico.
